title: Principal of Origination & Customer Products
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Blue Energy is transforming how nuclear power gets built. Instead of constructing each plant on-site from scratch - a process that takes 10-15 years and is too expensive and unpredictable to finance - we build our plants like ships: in a factory, on an assembly line, then transport and assemble them at the site. This cuts costs by over 60% and brings plants online in just three years. We also pair natural gas with nuclear at our sites, so customers can start receiving power from gas turbines right away and then switch over to clean nuclear power once it comes online - getting energy to the grid faster while nuclear is being built. Our mission is to make nuclear energy abundant, affordable, and repeatable at global scale. We use proven, already-approved reactor designs and work with existing nuclear and industrial sites, giving us a faster path to regulatory approval. By manufacturing this way, we put nuclear power on the same cost-reduction curve that has made wind, solar, and batteries cheaper every year.

**Role Summary**
----------------

Hyperscalers are a core component of Blue Energy’s near-term commercial strategy, alongside the broader data center and power ecosystem including colocation providers, neoclouds, data center developers, utilities, and other large-load customers and partners. These organizations need scalable, firm power and commercial structures that match how they develop, procure, and serve load. They are sophisticated counterparties, and transacting with them requires a deep understanding of their needs, supported by rigorous analysis, polished materials, and consistent, rapid execution across several accounts at once.

We are hiring a Principal, Origination & Customer Products to support that execution. This role builds the analysis and materials behind customer and partner conversations, runs the day-to-day of active deals, and helps design the products Blue Energy offers beyond the core power agre

title: Vice President of Market Strategy
description: Location : Denver, CO (Preferred) Target hire date : ASAP Type: Full-Time Employee Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a dynamic, experienced leader to join our team as Vice President (VP) of Market Strategy. The VP of Market Strategy is responsible for setting the policy strategy, market strategy, and accompanying goals for the markets in which Pivot participates, and then leading those outcomes. Key areas of management include market analysis, generating go-to-market plans, policy tracking and influencing, and executive sponsorship of select high-value opportunities. The VP will deliver these outcomes by building, leading, and developing a high-performing team of market strategy, policy, and market development professionals: setting priorities, allocating resources, and holding the team accountable to clear goals. Success in the role will be defined by identifying and maintaining solar, small utility, and BESS markets while maintaining and increasing Pivot’s market share in those markets. This will involve balancing resources across teams to both enter and exit markets to optimize our market mix and resources. This role is ultimately accountable for the team's preparation of and response to procurements within qualifying markets using innovative strategies to secure capacity. The role demands deep understanding of distributed energy resource market policy, wholesale market constructs, legislative & regulatory processes, site origination techniques, equipment and technology usages, modeling and rate analysis fluency, and working across teams to create healthy development environments for company growth. The role also requires the ability to lead executive-level discussions. This is a people-leadership position: the VP will spend the majority of their time setting direction for, coaching, and developing the teams. The role requires a kind, attentive focus to guide team members and work collaboratively across teams.
